name: Mining speed
effect: Always increases correct-tool mining speed.

name: Fortune
effect: Adds stochastically rounded native Fortune levels, combined cap X.

name: Magnetized
effect: Pulls only your freshly mined drops toward you, never thrown items.

name: Silk touch
effect: Chance to generate native Silk Touch loot; exclusive with the base Fortune and Smelter families.

name: Reinforced
effect: Increases maximum durability on any reconstructed tool.

name: Scholar
effect: Increases block and furnace experience; suppressed by Silk Touch.

name: Aquatic
effect: Recovers this fraction of the underwater mining penalty and also adds the same fraction as extra underwater speed. The bonus remains useful with native Aqua Affinity.

name: Steady hands
effect: Recovers this fraction of the native airborne mining penalty and adds the same fraction as extra airborne speed.

name: Long reach
effect: Adds native block interaction range in the main hand.

name: Smelter
effect: Chance to apply the real furnace recipe to each drop, preserving recipe counts and XP.

name: Phasebound
effect: Chance to put final mined drops directly into your inventory; overflow remains in the world.

name: Hardwearing
effect: Chance to prevent each durability point before native Unbreaking.

name: Deep reserves
effect: Adds flat maximum durability, after the Reinforced multiplier.

name: Self repair
effect: Repairs this held tool every five seconds.

name: Mending affinity
effect: Repairs extra durability on XP pickup without consuming additional player XP.

name: Frugal repairs
effect: Reduces anvil level and material costs on nonempty repairs; costs never fall below one.

name: Nugget maintenance
effect: While crouching, consumes an iron nugget every five seconds to repair durability.

name: Rain tempered
effect: Repairs every five seconds while exposed to rain or submerged.

name: Lightweight grip
effect: Adds main-hand movement speed as a fraction of base speed.

name: Braced grip
effect: Adds main-hand knockback resistance.

name: Guarded grip
effect: Adds main-hand armor points.

name: Vital grip
effect: Adds main-hand maximum health points; two points equal one heart.

name: Stonecutter
effect: Increases mining speed while common stone.

name: Ore runner
effect: Increases mining speed while ores.

name: Sediment cutter
effect: Increases mining speed while sand, gravel, clay or dirt.

name: Deep delver
effect: Increases mining speed while blocks below Y=0.

name: Sunstruck
effect: Increases mining speed while daylight with open sky.

name: Night shift
effect: Increases mining speed in low ambient light (below eight), including dark caves.

name: Water cooled
effect: Increases mining speed while rain or water.

name: Heat tempered
effect: Increases mining speed while the Nether or within two blocks of lava.

name: Planted stance
effect: Increases mining speed while standing still.

name: Mining rhythm
effect: Increases mining speed while up to five consecutive breaks less than three seconds apart.

name: Varied strata
effect: Increases mining speed while switching to a different block within three seconds.

name: Last legs
effect: Increases mining speed while less than 25% durability remaining.

name: Calibrated edge
effect: Increases mining speed while more than 75% durability remaining.

name: Prospector
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on any ore; combined Fortune is capped at X.

name: Gem cutter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on diamond, emerald or lapis ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.

name: Redstone savant
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on redstone ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.

name: Coal splitter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on coal ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.

name: Metal splitter
effect: Adds fractional native Fortune levels on iron, copper or gold ores; combined Fortune is capped at X.

name: Deep knowledge
effect: Additional mining XP below Y=0.

name: Ore knowledge
effect: Additional mining XP on ores.

name: Experienced rhythm
effect: Additional mining XP during a consecutive mining chain.

name: Experience condenser
effect: Banks half of primary mining XP. Every few breaks releases the bank with a bonus multiplier and resonance. Silk Touch disables this effect.

name: Echoing spoils
effect: Copies the first final drop stack, up to sixteen items per extra copy. Values above 100% can grant multiple extra copies. Disabled by Silk Touch, block entities and secondary breaks.

name: Gem echo
effect: Adds matching diamond, emerald or lapis after a primary gem ore break. The amount increases with ascension. Disabled by Silk Touch. Above 100% chance, extra echo batches are stochastically awarded.

name: Lucky edge
effect: Repairs twelve durability on a successful primary ore proc. Disabled by Silk Touch.

name: Gravel sifter
effect: Chance: Converts a gravel drop into flint. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.

name: Vitrifier
effect: Chance: Converts sand drops into glass. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.

name: Clay kiln
effect: Chance: Converts clay balls into bricks. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.

name: Stone smoother
effect: Chance: Converts cobblestone into stone. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.

name: Slate polisher
effect: Chance: Converts cobbled deepslate into polished deepslate. Disabled by Silk Touch. Applies to secondary excavation too.

name: Metal filings
effect: Chance: Adds bonus iron or gold nuggets after mining the corresponding ore. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.

name: Fossil dust
effect: Chance: Adds bonus bone meal when mining calcite or tuff. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.

name: Web salvage
effect: Chance: Adds bonus string when cutting cobweb. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.

name: Prismatic salvage
effect: Chance: Adds bonus amethyst shards when breaking an amethyst cluster. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.

name: Moss salvage
effect: Chance: Adds bone meal when mining moss. Disabled by Silk Touch and on secondary breaks. Amount increases at ascension milestones.

name: Vein miner
effect: Crouch mining excavates connected same-type ores. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Tunneler
effect: Crouch mining excavates a straight bore behind the target. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Broadhead
effect: Crouch mining excavates a full 3x3 plane, then two layers, a 5x5 plane and finally two 5x5 layers. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Stairmaker
effect: Crouch mining excavates a two-block-high descending passage. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Surface scraper
effect: Crouch mining excavates nearby matching sediment. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Gravel vacuum
effect: Crouch mining excavates the sand or gravel column above the target. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Branching veins
effect: Crouch mining excavates connected ores of mixed types. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Crystal sweep
effect: Crouch mining excavates nearby mature amethyst clusters, preserving budding amethyst. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Obsidian chisel
effect: Crouch mining excavates nearby matching obsidian. Shares a 64-extra-block budget within loaded range. Native breaks consume durability and respect cancellation. Never targets block entities or farms secondary tool XP, bonus drops or charge.

name: Support mason
effect: Places inventory cobblestone below the mined cell when it is unsupported. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Lightbearer
effect: Places an inventory torch in the mined cell when light is low. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Lava cork
effect: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed lava cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Water cork
effect: Consumes cobblestone to plug one adjacent exposed water cell. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Bridgework
effect: While crouching, places inventory cobblestone directly beneath your feet. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Green thumb
effect: Consumes bone meal to turn nearby exposed dirt into grass, never replacing other blocks. Placement events can cancel; resources are consumed only on success.

name: Night sight
effect: Grants long Night Vision on a primary break. Frequent refresh avoids the short-duration flicker.

name: Prospector sprint
effect: Grants Speed after a primary ore break; later stages improve duration and amplifier.

name: Stone skin
effect: Grants Resistance after primary stone mining; later stages improve duration and amplifier.

name: Fire ward
effect: Grants Fire Resistance after a primary break near lava or while burning.

name: Gem ward
effect: Grants and recharges temporary absorption hearts after a primary gem ore break. Two health points equal one heart.

name: Soft landing
effect: Grants Slow Falling after an airborne primary break.

name: Echo chamber
effect: Slows nearby hostile mobs after an ore break; never targets players or animals.

name: Quarry mark
effect: Makes nearby hostile mobs glow after an ore break.

name: Desperate pulse
effect: Below half health, a primary break knocks nearby enemies away and heals you. Does not target players or passive mobs.

name: Air pockets
effect: Restores air ticks on underwater primary breaks.

name: Miner sustenance
effect: Restores food points and saturation after primary mining when hungry. The chance is quality-adjusted.

name: Recoil step
effect: Right-click air to blink backward. Only loaded, dry, collision-free destinations with a solid floor are valid. No automatic movement while mining.

name: Resonant battery
effect: Generates additional resonance on primary breaks. All reconstructed pickaxes also have a quality-scaled resonant core. Total capacity: 200.

name: Overcharge
effect: Spends resonance after primary mining for Haste. Milestones improve duration and amplifier.

name: Gem battery
effect: Generates extra resonance on gem ore breaks.

name: Kinetic battery
effect: Moving at least one block while holding the tool generates resonance at most once per second. Milestones increase the amount.

name: Experience battery
effect: Trades one current primary mining XP for resonance. Does not consume existing player XP or generate XP.

name: Quarry discharge
effect: Spends resonance to mine an expanding horizontal cross around a primary break. Crouch to enable; shares the total area budget.

name: Spoils discharge
effect: Spends resonance to copy part of the first final primary drop. Disabled by Silk Touch and block entities.

name: Mending discharge
effect: Spends resonance after primary mining to restore a large amount of durability to this tool.

name: Shared momentum
effect: Spends resonance after primary mining to grant Haste to you and nearby allied players. Works in solo play.

name: Alternating current
effect: Alternating ore and stone breaks within three seconds generates resonance.

name: Knowledge siphon
effect: Grants mining XP directly with a milestone bonus and repairs this pickaxe. Mending Affinity multiplies the repair; native Mending adds its repair rate. No XP orbs remain for other equipment.

name: Apprentice resonance
effect: Adds stochastically rounded extra tool XP after valid primary mining. Unpaid ascension gates still block XP. At level 100, extra XP instead grants twice as much player XP and resonance.

name: Careful mason
effect: Chance not to consume the material for a successful utility placement; you must still own it.

name: Precision silk
effect: Silk Touch chance while standing still. Shares the base harvest exclusion group.

name: Pocket press
effect: Compacts plain inventory resources using their native crafting ratios after mining. Stage 0: raw metals and nuggets. Stage 1: coal, redstone, lapis. Stage 2: diamonds, emeralds, quartz, amethyst. Stage 3: netherite ingots. Batches increase with stage. Named or component-bearing inputs are excluded.

name: Spoils ward
effect: Temporarily prevents damage to your final mined drops via the native invulnerability-check event; underlying entity flags remain unchanged.

name: Choking dust
effect: Primary sediment mining pulses Weakness on nearby hostile mobs. Never targets players or passive mobs.

name: Pyroclastic
effect: Adds furnace-recipe processing chance and up to 75% extra furnace output, plus furnace XP. Yield bonus is 25% of this effective value. Disabled by Silk Touch.

name: Cinder chain
effect: Each successful primary furnace-processing event generates resonance. Also contributes smelting chance equal to 4% per effective point, so it can work alone.

name: Soul furnace
effect: Pays resonance to smelt every eligible primary drop and its secondary excavation chain. Milestones add output yield and furnace XP. No player XP cost. Silk Touch still wins.

name: Basalt heart
effect: Primary Nether stone mining repairs durability and grants Resistance.

name: Magma reservoir
effect: Mining near lava generates resonance.

name: Soul cleanse
effect: Mining soul sand, soul soil or Nether rock removes negative effects and grants Regeneration. Removes Poison, Wither, Slowness and Weakness in that order.

name: Piglin purse
effect: Adds gold nuggets on a primary gold ore or gilded blackstone proc. Disabled by Silk Touch.

name: Ghast breath
effect: Spends resonance after primary mining to knock away and ignite nearby enemies. Never targets players or passive mobs.

name: Emberlight
effect: Spends resonance to create a soul torch in a dark, supported mined cell. Native placement cancellation still applies.

name: Infernal echo
effect: Spends resonance to break connected Nether ores, including ancient debris, with furnace processing on its secondary blocks. Crouch to enable. Shares the area budget.

name: Chorus hop
effect: Sneak-right-click air to spend resonance and blink forward. Requires a loaded, dry, collision-free destination with a solid floor. Does not teleport automatically during mining.

name: Ender dispatch
effect: Collects primary drops into inventory and sends overflow to the Ender Chest. Higher stages also retrieve your owned freshly mined drops at range. Full containers leave exact remainders in the world.

name: Repulsor
effect: Primary ore mining knocks enemies away and reflects enemy-owned projectiles. Never reflects player or dispenser projectiles.

name: Entanglement
effect: Refunds a fraction of resonance spent by this tool and shares the same refund with nearby allied wielders. Useful alone. Refunds never recursively trigger more refunds.

name: Temporal echo
effect: Spends resonance to prime extra copied items on the next primary break within thirty seconds. A successful echo consumes the priming. Disabled by Silk Touch and block entities.

name: Shulker pulse
effect: Spends resonance after primary mining to levitate nearby enemies. Never targets players or passive mobs.

name: Endstone alchemy
effect: Spends resonance after primary End Stone mining for a chance of bonus ender pearls. Disabled by Silk Touch.

name: Void anchor
effect: Returns you from below the world to a safe same-dimension position recorded while holding this tool. Pays resonance or emergency durability if charge is insufficient. One quality roll per fall, with a milestone cooldown. Only loaded, dry, safe destinations qualify.

name: Dimensional battery
effect: Directly collects your mined drops and retrieves owned freshly mined drops nearby. Successful collection in the primary mining event generates resonance once. Remote collection cannot farm charge.
